The sample holds 28 Normal, 28 each of DoS, Probe and R2L, and 20 U2R records, with half of each attack class drawn from attack types absent from training. It is balanced by design, so its accuracy is not comparable to the report's 22,544-record results, which are shown in the last column as five-seed means. The models here are the seed-0 refit of the frozen configurations, so single predictions can differ slightly from those means.

Data: NSL-KDD KDDTest+ benchmark records (1999 DARPA-derived traffic features), not live network traffic. Feature scaling matches the training pipeline. The Decision Tree, SVM, MLP and LSTM outputs were checked against scikit-learn and Keras on all 132 records (same class on every record). Information Security Lab mini project.
